<!-- Generated by `ovid2 manual gen-reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each formatter spec picks exactly one adapter. Adapters are framework-level — never add a per-pipeline one. Authoring guide: [Formatter specs](../06-authoring/formatters.md).

| Adapter | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `custom` | Adapter that delegates to a hand-written `BaseFormatter`. |
| `omop_concept_join` | Adapter for OMOP source data that needs CONCEPT translation. |
| `semantic_join` | Adapter that joins sources against one or more registered vocabularies. |
| `source_passthrough` | Read one or more sources and return their name-wise union. |
| `union_of_specs` | Adapter that unions the outputs of several sub-specs. |

Deprecated aliases: `pcornet_passthrough` → `source_passthrough`.
